minutes.headline: School Committee approved FY24 handbooks and calendar, and deferred the Turkey Hill future question to a summer meeting.
minutes.summary: The committee approved the May 3 minutes, the FY24 school handbooks and the 2023-24 meeting calendar. It heard the superintendent's report, spring iReady math and reading results, a revised standards-based report card, the Amplify ELA curriculum, and the family-school partnership report. Members discussed what to do about Turkey Hill Elementary long term and agreed to table it to a summer meeting and seek input from the select board chair and municipal building committee. The meeting ended with a motion to go into executive session on security.

public_comment.topic: A committee member's comment on defining equity, in response to an earlier question.
A resident thanked the superintendent for the PTO fundraiser lunch prize and said she supports equal opportunity but not equal outcomes.
A parent thanked the PTO for the Hollis Hills fundraiser.

votes.motion: Approve the school committee calendar for 2023-24
Go into executive session to discuss security deployment and adjourn following

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair noted there were no line item transfers.
From July 1 a contractor will provide IT director functions, replacing the prior provider.
Chair said keeping the building going would cost a large sum, and discussion covered MSBA funding conditions and avoiding spending on a building later torn down.
A member recalled a resident asking why money would be spent on the front end of TCP but not on Turkey Hill.

decisions.decision: Turkey Hill future discussion will be put on a summertime meeting; members to reach out to the select board chair and municipal building committee for input and consider a public forum.
May 24 minutes will be reviewed at the next meeting.
A final off-cycle meeting by Zoom on June 29 will review purchase orders to carry over.
